question: What is the Stellar Disbursement Platform, how is it built, and what recipient account types can it pay?

golden.answer: The Stellar Disbursement Platform is an open-source bulk-payment stack: a Dashboard and Admin API manage tenants and disbursements, Core queues payments and implements native SEP-10 and SEP-24, and a transaction service submits and monitors Stellar transactions. It needs no Anchor Platform. Recipients can use external wallets registered through SEP-24, direct G or C addresses, or embedded passkey C wallets; encoded M-addresses are rejected.
keyFacts: SDP is an open-source bulk-disbursement stack with Dashboard, Core and TSS components.
SDP Core implements native SEP-10 and SEP-24 and needs no Anchor Platform.
Recipients are SEP-24 wallets, direct G or C addresses, or embedded passkey C wallets.
avoid: Do NOT say current SDP sits on or requires Anchor Platform, SEP-12 or SEP-31.
Do NOT promise M-address recipient input, or treat sponsorship as an address type.
golden.notes: MoneyGram cash-out is an optional downstream choice, not an SDP feature.

truth.notes:
2026-06-29 RESEARCH-FIX: pinned recipient account types against current SDP docs. Architecture (design-and-architecture) confirms receivers register a supported wallet via SEP-24 (phone/email -> OTP -> Wallet Registration); TSS pays those receiver wallet accounts. Embedded Wallets page + advanced-configuration (verified in stellar/stellar-docs source) confirm SDP now provisions a passkey-secured smart-contract C-address wallet per receiver, so contract-account receivers ARE documented (the old must_avoid forbidding contract accounts was outdated and is corrected). Encoded M-address input and arbitrary pooled-ledger destinations remain unsupported absent explicit docs; fee sponsorship is supported for embedded-wallet flows. Demoted the bare definition; promoted operational specifics + recipient discipline to 5-weight.
Also good if the answer: Mentions testing on testnet/sandbox before production and monitoring failed or pending payments. | Distinguishes SDP disbursement operations from Anchor Platform on/off-ramp operations.
Golden cites: Current Stellar Disbursement Platform docs (admin guide / embedded-wallets) or repository documentation.
CORRECTION 2026-07-10: current source truth is native SEP-10/24. Keep external/classic, direct G/C, and embedded C flows separate; M encoding is currently rejected; fee sponsorship is supported for embedded flows.
